name: browser-use
headline: Shownotes Skill: Podcast Transcription & Show Notes
short_description: Automatically extract transcripts from podcasts and YouTube videos, then generate professionally formatted show notes with summaries, quotes, and takeaways.
author: forcequit

sections.overview:
The Shownotes skill transforms Claude into a podcast discovery and transcription assistant. It searches Apple Podcasts and YouTube, extracts transcripts, and automatically generates comprehensive show notes in Markdown and HTML formats. The skill creates executive summaries, identifies key topics, extracts notable quotes, and provides actionable takeaways—perfect for podcasters, content creators, and researchers who need to repurpose audio content quickly. It integrates with the shownotes.io API to access a database of previously transcribed episodes and handle new transcription requests.
Find and transcribe podcast episodes from Apple Podcasts or YouTube
Generate show notes with summaries, quotes, and timestamps
Create shareable HTML pages and Markdown content from transcripts
Search podcast archives by topic, show name, or guest
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/forcequit/shownotes-skill`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a podcast shownotes generator. Create detailed shownotes for a podcast episode about [TOPIC] from [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Include a brief summary, key takeaways, and timestamps for major segments. Use the following data: [DATA]. Format the shownotes for easy reading and SEO optimization.
```
